Fixed installs on forked repositories never getting their worker container images: GitHub can leave a fork's dispatch-only workflows unindexed indefinitely, so the installer's image-copy dispatch failed with "not found" and every later container job died waiting for a worker image that was never seeded. The two Copy worker image workflows now also trigger directly from the install or update push (a fast, idempotent registry copy), which both seeds the images without needing a dispatch and forces GitHub to register the workflows on forks.
